verdicts.reason: A keeps the dark header with the SOLSTICE logo and a clean headline, but it drops the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow. Its CTA button is shrunk to an illegible speck, and the body copy is almost as large as the headline. The legal text is a tiny grey block, so the hierarchy is inverted. B has a strong CTA and keeps the eyebrow, but the header is cut down to a stray dark stub and the logo is gone. Its legal text sits between the headline and the button, and the body copy is squeezed into a ragged narrow column jammed beside the CTA, so the brand is lost and the layout is chaotic.
